text: It was a seal the emperor of China sent to a king of the Wa in the year 57: proof that real kings ruled the islands long before the chronicles.
spoken: It was a seal the emperor of China sent to a king of the Wa in the year fifty-seven: proof that real kings ruled the islands long before the chronicles.
